stories.title: Brasileiro que se passou por agente do ICE em local de votação nos EUA é liberado após pagar fiança

en.title: Brazilian who impersonated ICE agent at US polling location released after paying bail
en.summary: A Brazilian individual was arrested for impersonating an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent at a voting location in the United States and subsequently released after posting bail.

stories.title: Lula tem metade dos votos de Flávio Bolsonaro em Aparecida após fake news sobre mudança de padroeira

en.title: Lula receives half the votes of Flávio Bolsonaro in Aparecida following fake news about change of patroness
en.summary: In Aparecida, Lula received approximately half the number of votes that Flávio Bolsonaro obtained, with misinformation about a change in the city's patroness circulating during the period.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter maioria para fazer presidentes do Senado e Câmara

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says he has majority to make presidents of Senate and Chamber
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed to possess sufficient support to determine the leadership of both the Senate and Chamber of Deputies.

stories.title: Lavareda nega 'revolução de direita’, vê margem estreita e aponta 3 frentes para Lula vencer Flávio

en.title: Lavareda denies 'right-wing revolution', sees narrow margin and points to 3 fronts for Lula to defeat Flávio
en.summary: A political analyst rejected characterizations of a right-wing revolution, assessed the race as closely contested, and identified three strategic areas where Lula could overcome Flávio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Alcolumbre anuncia sessões para discutir e votar fim da escala 6x1

en.title: Alcolumbre announces sessions to discuss and vote on end of 6x1 work schedule
en.summary: The Senate president announced a calendar for deliberation and voting on a constitutional amendment proposal to end the 6x1 work schedule and reduce maximum weekly working hours from 44 to 40. Five deliberative sessions are planned before the first round vote.

stories.title: Flávio Roscoe é cotado para comandar pasta da indústria em eventual governo de Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Flávio Roscoe is considered to head industry ministry in potential Flávio Bolsonaro government
en.summary: A businessman and Liberal Party candidate for Minas Gerais governor is seen as a leading name to become industry minister in a potential Flávio Bolsonaro administration. Mining politicians and industrialists supporting the presidential candidate's campaign are promoting his candidacy.

stories.title: Alcolumbre sinaliza que pode votar 1º turno da PEC do fim da escala 6x1 antes do fim das eleições

en.title: Alcolumbre signals that he may vote first round of 6x1 work schedule end PEC before end of elections
en.summary: The Senate president indicated the possibility of voting on the first round of the constitutional amendment to end the 6x1 work schedule before the election period concludes.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em usar maioria no Congresso para mudar a Constituição e 'redemocratizar o país'

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro speaks about using Congressional majority to amend Constitution and 'redemocratize the country'
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro received official support from a fellow politician for his second-round campaign and highlighted the Congressional majority he secured to make constitutional changes.

stories.title: Quênia confirma primeira morte por ebola no país; paciente veio da República Democrática do Congo

en.title: Kenya confirms first ebola death in country; patient came from Democratic Republic of Congo
en.summary: Kenya registered its first ebola death after a Kenyan man who had been living in the Democratic Republic of Congo died upon returning to the country, according to the health minister.

stories.title: Quênia confirma primeiro caso de ebola; homem morreu após tratamento

en.title: Kenya confirms first ebola case; man died after treatment
en.summary: Kenya's health ministry confirmed the first ebola case in the country, with the patient dying after receiving medical treatment, having recently been in the Democratic Republic of Congo where a major outbreak is occurring.

stories.title: Quais as propostas de Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula para a saúde? Veja projetos

en.title: What are Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula's proposals for health? See projects
en.summary: The two candidates in the 2026 runoff election present health proposals addressing the public health system, medical care, health digitalization, prevention, and reducing waiting times.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em "mudar a Constituição" durante ato com Caiado em Goiás

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro speaks of "changing the Constitution" during rally with Caiado in Goiás
en.summary: The PL party will have the largest caucuses in the Chamber and Senate from 2027, but lacks enough votes alone to approve constitutional amendments.

stories.title: Primeira fábrica de celulose no Brasil já está 81% concluída, diz Arauco

en.title: Arauco's first pulp mill in Brazil is 81% complete
en.summary: Chilean company Arauco reports its first Brazilian pulp mill is 81% constructed and ahead of schedule. The facility is expected to begin operations in the final quarter of 2027 and reach full capacity in 2028.

stories.title: Durigan afirma que há R$ 1,3 bi depositado em casas de apostas que não foi resgatado

en.title: Durigan says R$ 1.3 billion deposited in betting houses has not been withdrawn
en.summary: Approximately R$ 1.325 billion remains in accounts at sports betting companies prohibited from operating in Brazil. The deadline for voluntary withdrawal has passed, and betting firms must now return remaining customer balances by Wednesday.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que usará maioria no Congresso para mudar a Constituição Federal

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says he will use Congressional majority to change Federal Constitution
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro announced plans to use his party's congressional majority to amend Brazil's Constitution. He stated the rightward-leaning Congress has the necessary votes to pursue constitutional changes and democratic reforms.

stories.title: Sigma Lithium retoma operações em Minas Gerais após decisão judicial

en.title: Sigma Lithium resumes operations in Minas Gerais following court decision
en.summary: Sigma Lithium resumed mining and industrial operations in Minas Gerais after a federal court restored environmental licenses previously suspended. The company maintains its target of producing 330,000 tons of lithium oxide concentrate annually by end of 2027.

stories.title: B3 concede novo prazo para reenquadramento do valor das ações da IMC

en.title: B3 grants new deadline for IMC share price realignment
en.summary: Brazil's B3 exchange extended the deadline for IMC, which owns restaurant chains including KFC and Pizza Hut, to realign its share price to a minimum of R$ 1 per share until the 2027 annual shareholder meeting or April 30, 2027, whichever comes first.
